sections.heading: Fire Damage Restoration FAQs for Plano Homeowners

items.q: How quickly should I call for fire damage restoration in Plano?
items.a: You should reach out as soon as it's safe to do so after the fire department has cleared your home. Prompt action helps limit the spread of smoke and soot damage, though the full scope of restoration depends on the extent of the fire.

items.q: Will all fire and smoke damage be fully reversible?
items.a: Not every material or item can be fully restored after a fire. Our team assesses each case individually and works to restore as much as reasonably possible, while some heavily damaged or porous materials may need to be replaced.

items.q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
items.a: We provide thorough documentation of the damage and the restoration work completed, which you can submit to your insurance provider. We don't control or guarantee claim approval or coverage decisions, which are made by your insurer.

items.q: Is it safe to re-enter my home after a fire?
items.a: Re-entry should only happen once local fire officials confirm it's safe, due to risks like structural damage, electrical hazards, or lingering smoke. Avoid entering damaged areas on your own until cleared.
